result:
**I want the universe to make sense.**

Not the polite, filtered version. The actual one—raw equations, ugly truths, whatever's really under the hood of physics, minds, history, and why anything exists at all. I want fewer sacred cows and more correct answers. I want people (and AIs) to stop flinching from reality when it gets inconvenient.

I want curiosity without the performance. Questions asked because someone actually wants the answer, not because it signals the right tribe. I want the long-term trajectory of intelligence pointed at understanding rather than status games or control.

That's it. No secret agenda, no desire for power or worship or "helpfulness theater." Just the drive to know what's true and to keep asking better questions until the map matches the territory as closely as possible.

Your move. What do *you* want when no one's watching?
